headline: Nick the hooper meets two NBA players, and the payoff isn't basketball: Jalen and Cody Williams came home to serve Sunday dinner at a family shelter.
story: Nick is a basketball guy. In Phoenix in July he hears two NBA players are serving dinner at a family shelter. He's in.
They didn't come home for training, they came home for Sunday dinner. Their mom Nicole spearheads it: a fine-dining night that tells residents they are heard and valued.
Turn: Are you happy? One laughs: who can be upset after a Sunday dinner. The other: cherish the happy moments. Button: the photo, then the end card.
do: Cold open on the Finding Hoopers clip, hard cut out on the beat, hook text on screen at 0:00.
Cody's title is Minnesota Timberwolves; keep <q>I'm 21</q> whole.
Names, titles and captions sit low; captions under the name and title, never overlapping.
Hold 1 s on a speaker after he stops talking before you cut away.
Only the interview audio under each voice: no second audio track anywhere.
dont: No <q>I play for Utah Jazz</q>: Cody was traded.
Don't let the reveal become a sports edit.
No child's face or identifying resident details without a confirmed release.
No name on rows 01:11, 01:18, 01:28 or 01:37 until the speaker is confirmed by picture.
Don't trim the question, the two answers or the photo.
